```plato
//==
// # Render
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Tone mapping, anti-aliasing, and post-processing
//  - Render settings
//  - Vertex data layout

//==
// # Tone mapping, anti-aliasing, and post-processing
//
// The image-space stages a renderer applies after shading, gathered as plain
// settings records: tone mapping, edge anti-aliasing, ambient occlusion, bloom,
// and distance fog. Distances are unit-agnostic scene Numbers; exposure
// compensation is in photographic stops (EV).

// The curve compressing HDR radiance into display range; None clamps.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tone_mapping)
type Tonemap = None | Reinhard | Aces | Filmic | Agx;

// Tone mapping controls. ExposureCompensation is in photographic stops (EV;
// +1 doubles brightness), applied before the curve; WhitePoint is the input
// level mapped to display white (its exact meaning is curve-dependent).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exposure_value)
type ToneMappingSettings
    implements IValue
{
    Curve: Tonemap;
    ExposureCompensation: Number;
    WhitePoint: Number;
}

// The edge anti-aliasing technique: hardware multisampling with its sample
// count (Msaa), fast post-process (Fxaa), temporal (Taa), or morphological
// (Smaa). (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spatial_anti-aliasing)
type AntiAliasing
    = None
    | Msaa(SampleCount: Integer)
    | Fxaa
    | Taa
    | Smaa;

// Screen-space ambient occlusion controls. Radius is the occlusion search
// distance in scene units; Intensity scales the darkening; Bias offsets
// samples to avoid self-occlusion; SampleCount trades quality for speed.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ambient_occlusion)
type AmbientOcclusionSettings
    implements IValue
{
    Enabled: Boolean;
    Radius: Number;
    Intensity: Number;
    Bias: Number;
    SampleCount: Integer;
}

// Bloom: glow bleeding from bright pixels. Threshold is the luminance above
// which pixels contribute; Intensity scales the added glow; Radius is the
// blur spread as a fraction of screen height.
// See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bloom_(shader_effect).
type BloomSettings
    implements IValue
{
    Enabled: Boolean;
    Threshold: Number;
    Intensity: Number;
    Radius: Number;
}

// The distance-fog model, each case carrying its own controls: Linear fades
// between Start and End (scene units); the exponential models are driven by
// Density; Height fog's density decays with altitude at HeightFalloff.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distance_fog)
type FogModel
    = None
    | Linear(Start: Number, End: Number)
    | Exponential(Density: Number)
    | ExponentialSquared(Density: Number)
    | Height(Density: Number, HeightFalloff: Number);

// Fog controls: the model plus the fog color.
type FogSettings
    implements IValue
{
    Model: FogModel;
    Color: Color;
}

//==
// # Render settings
//
// Backend-neutral descriptions of render targets, vertex data layout,
// post-processing, and renderer quality. Distances are unit-agnostic scene
// Numbers; frame times are Durations; exposure compensation is in
// photographic stops (EV).

// Describes an on-screen or off-screen render target. ColorFormat uses the
// pixel formats of `images.types.plato`; SampleCount is the MSAA sample count (1 = no
// multisampling); HasDepth requests a depth attachment.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Framebuffer)
type RenderTargetDescriptor
    implements IValue
{
    Size: IntegerSize2D;
    ColorFormat: PixelFormat;
    HasDepth: Boolean;
    SampleCount: Integer;
}

//==
// # Path tracing, shadows, and output

// The denoiser applied to a path-traced image: real-time temporal (Fast) or
// offline machine-learning based (HighQuality).
type Denoiser = None | Fast | HighQuality;

// Path-tracing quality controls. SamplesPerPixel and MaxBounces bound the
// integration work; RadianceClamp caps per-sample radiance to suppress
// fireflies (0 = unclamped); Seed makes runs reproducible.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Path_tracing)
type PathTracingSettings
    implements IValue
{
    SamplesPerPixel: Integer;
    MaxBounces: Integer;
    RadianceClamp: Number;
    Denoiser: Denoiser;
    Seed: Integer;
}

// The shadow-map filtering technique: percentage-closer (Pcf),
// contact-hardening (Pcss), variance (Vsm), or exponential (Esm).
type ShadowFilter = Hard | Pcf | Pcss | Vsm | Esm;

// An overall speed-versus-fidelity preset a renderer maps onto its own knobs.
type QualityPreset = Draft | Preview | Production;

// Which triangle facing is culled during rasterization; None draws both
// faces. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Back-face_culling)
type FaceCulling = None | Back | Front;

// The color encoding of the final displayed image. Distinct from working
// color spaces (the `color-spaces-*` files): this names the presentation encoding only.
// Rec2020Pq is HDR10.
type DisplayColorSpace
    = SrgbNonlinear | LinearRec709 | DisplayP3 | Rec2020Pq | Rec2020Hlg;
```
